title: Worker report
description: The one JSON object a worker ends its session with. Saved as .work/reports/<part>.json.

status.description: done: the part is committed on the worker's branch and `npm run check` is green there; the lead merges it into main afterwards. blocked: the worker stopped; openQuestions says on what.

summary.description: What was built and committed on the branch, or where and why the worker stopped. A few sentences.

filesChanged.description: Repo-relative paths the part added or changed, e.g. src/csv.ts. Empty if nothing was changed.

checks.description: Result of the last `npm run check`: green, red, or not run.

openQuestions.description: Questions only the owner or the lead can answer. Required to be non-empty when status is blocked.
